question: Related Questions Q. As Salaamualaikum dear Mufti sahib. My father has two sisters. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 22703 Country: India Title: Request to answer the below question enlighten with hadith & Quran We have received a Tarka for my late mother . We have received this after the expiry of my mother and father. My Father?s family consist of 2 sons and six sisters.All are married and well settled. We have received an amount 300,000 Rupees as for my mother. My question is wheather all my sisters(I mean Brothers & Sisters) are eligible for this tarka of my mother or it?s only for sons. If yes ,to the daughters and sons , I would like to shares in percentage. Question: Request to answer the below question enlighten with hadith & Quran We have received a Tarka for my late mother . We have received this after the expiry of my mother and father. My Father?s family consist of 2 sons and six sisters.All are married and well settled. We have received an amount 300,000 Rupees as for my mother. My question is wheather all my sisters(I mean Brothers & Sisters) are eligible for this tarka of my mother or it?s only for sons. If yes ,to the daughters and sons , I would like to shares in percentage. Answer ID: 22703 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! All the brothers and sisters shall be eligible to get inheritance from the property of mother. In the case mentioned above, after due rights preceding inheritance, all the property of your deceased mother (cash etc) shall be divided into ten shares. Each daughter shall get 1-1 share while each son 2-2 shares. Detail: Son: 2x2= 4 Daughter: 1x6= 6 Total: 10 Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
